what: Joint preparation of refreshments and lighting for a civic hospitality gathering is supported: innkeeper, builder and freight organized it, baker supplied bread, and secretary arranged the approved appointment and escort. However, preparation of something the mayor was not told about is not established. The mayor was told of the meeting, committee, refreshments, deliveries and hall lighting. No confirmed surprise celebration or bridge/port change is supported; vague reports and missing details do not establish concealment. Probability of an undisclosed joint preparation: 0.22.
